1. $r_{im}=y_i-F_{m-1}(x_i)$.
2. $F_m=F_{m-1}+\nu f_m$.
3. The pseudo-residuals $\{r_{im}\}$ at the training $x_i$.
4. Shrinkage slows fitting and usually improves generalization (with larger $M$).
5. The training mean $\bar{y}$ (minimizer of total squared error among constants).
